text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The day of the Shuka Sho has arrived. As for how the spectators who have followed the Tiara path this far feel—

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Even so, I guess Harp Alpha's still the favorite.
Coming off a break is a bit concerning, but...
there's no doubt she's strong!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
I think I'd choose Yukino Bijin-chan.
That charming appeal that makes you want to cheer for her is one of a kind! And she's got real skill, too♪

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
North Flight did great in the Fuchu Umamusume Stakes too, but...
I wonder if she's feeling alright now?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having taken such a cautious and measured path so far,
North Flight has received somewhat modest evaluations. Even so—

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Yes, the hairstyle is...
perfect too♪

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"I'd be lying if I said I wasn't feeling
tired from the Fuchu Umamusume Stakes, but..."

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
I'm waaaay less fatigued than before!
I can run at full power!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Trainer.
What do you think... of my outfit for today?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Of course, I don't mean her literal racing outfit.
I mean what she decided to wear today for the Shuka Sho...
her mindset, her strategy, and everything else.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The preparations for her to shine her brightest today, at this Shuka Sho, are—

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Thank you.
—Well, I'm off then.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Pardon?
choice_data_list: Go out there and have an extraordinary adventure.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
This once-in-a-lifetime outfit...
—I'm going to enjoy it to the fullest!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Hawawa~.
Everyone's in such amazing shape...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Still, I've worked real hard for today,
too, y'know!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I took good care of all my weak spots...
and even built up plenty of power.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"The Shuka Sho is...!
I-I'm taking it for myself!"

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
(Everyone is making the most of their natural charms, polishing them...
and putting together a style that is uniquely their own.)

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
(Not just me. Everyone here
is dressed up in their absolute finest.)

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
It's so wonderful...
Everyone is shining. But!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: "Aren't I dressed up enough... to make your heart flutter?"
